headline: HOU @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.84 at TEX 4.16, with a projected total of 8.00. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved +0.50 runs while TEX moved -0.14, changing the projected margin by +0.64 runs. The projected total climbed +0.37, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jake Burger, Isaac Paredes, Ezequiel Duran, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach Cole, Andrew McCutchen because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
